name.zh: 明治日本的产业革命遗址
name.en: Sites of Japan's Meiji Industrial Revolution

description.zh: 这一遗产群由分布在九州、山口等地的23处工业遗址组成，涵盖制铁、造船、煤矿等领域，展示了日本在19世纪后半叶如何迅速完成工业化并跻身世界强国。2015年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: This serial property spans 23 industrial sites across Kyushu, Yamaguchi and elsewhere, covering iron and steel, shipbuilding and coal mining. Together they document Japan's breathtaking transition to a world industrial power in the second half of the 19th century. UNESCO-listed in 2015.

location.zh: 九州、山口等地共23处（长崎、熊本、福冈、鹿儿岛等）
location.en: 23 sites across Kyushu and Yamaguchi (Nagasaki, Kumamoto, Fukuoka, Kagoshima, etc.)

zh: 军舰岛（端岛）：曾是全球人口密度最高的岛屿，现为废墟观光地
三菱长崎造船所：日本工业化起点之一，仍在运作
官营八幡制铁所：近代日本最早的大型钢铁厂
en: Hashima (Gunkanjima): once the world's most densely populated island, now a haunting ruin open for tours
Mitsubishi Nagasaki Shipyard: one of Japan's first modern shipyards, still operational
Yawata Steel Works: Japan's first large-scale modern steelworks

admission.zh: 各遗址收费不同；军舰岛船票约4,000—5,000日元
admission.en: Varies by site; Gunkanjima boat tour ~¥4,000–5,000

duration.zh: 各遗址散布各地，建议选择2—3处重点参观
duration.en: Sites are spread across different cities; choose 2–3 key sites per trip

tips.zh: 长崎的军舰岛观光船每天出发，但受天气影响可能停航；提前网络预约避免售罄。
tips.en: Gunkanjima boat tours depart daily from Nagasaki but may be cancelled in bad weather. Book online in advance to avoid sell-outs.

name.zh: 长崎与天草地区潜伏基督徒相关遗产
name.en: Hidden Christian Sites in the Nagasaki Region

description.zh: 禁教令下的日本基督徒（隐れキリシタン）在长崎及天草的偏僻村落秘密维持信仰长达250年，留下了一批独特的教堂与村落景观。2018年列入UNESCO世界遗产，包含12处组成遗产。
description.en: During Japan's 250-year ban on Christianity, 'hidden Christians' (kakure kirishitan) secretly maintained their faith in remote Nagasaki and Amakusa villages, producing a unique blend of Christian and Shinto-Buddhist practice. The 12-component serial property was UNESCO-listed in 2018.

location.zh: 长崎县（五岛列岛、平户、大浦天主堂等）及熊本县天草
location.en: Nagasaki Prefecture (Goto Islands, Hirado, Oura Cathedral) and Amakusa, Kumamoto

zh: 大浦天主堂：日本现存唯一的国宝天主教教堂（1865年）
五岛列岛上散布的哥特式石造教堂群
平户岛的田平天主堂与禁教时代秘密礼拜遗址
en: Oura Cathedral, Nagasaki: Japan's only national-treasure Catholic church (1865)
Gothic stone churches scattered across the Goto Islands
Hirado Island's Tabira Church and secret worship sites from the prohibition era

admission.zh: 大浦天主堂1,000日元；各岛教堂大多免费
admission.en: Oura Cathedral ¥1,000; island churches mostly free

duration.zh: 长崎市区一天；五岛列岛需2—3天
duration.en: Nagasaki city 1 day; Goto Islands 2–3 days

tips.zh: 五岛列岛需从长崎乘高速船约1—1.5小时，住宿选择有限，建议提前预订。大浦天主堂附近的旧居留地也值得漫步。
tips.en: The Goto Islands require a 1–1.5 hour jetfoil from Nagasaki — accommodation is limited so book ahead. The old foreign settlement near Oura Cathedral is worth a stroll.

name.zh: 雲仙火山地区世界地质公园
name.en: Unzen Volcanic Area UNESCO Global Geopark

description.zh: 雲仙火山地质公园覆盖长崎县岛原半岛全域，以「活火山与人类共生」为主题。约50万年前开始活动的雲仙岳至今仍在喷发，1990—1995年的大喷发夺去43条生命，留下的火山碎屑流遗迹被完整保存，温泉与农业文化也因火山馈赠而蓬勃发展。2009年加入UNESCO全球地质公园网络。
description.en: Unzen Volcanic Area UNESCO Global Geopark covers the entire Shimabara Peninsula in Nagasaki Prefecture under the theme 'coexistence of an active volcano and human beings.' Unzen-dake, active for around 500,000 years, last erupted catastrophically in 1990–1995, killing 43 people; the pyroclastic flow debris is preserved as a monument. The volcano's gifts — hot springs, fertile soil and spring water — sustain the local community. Designated in 2009.

location.zh: 长崎县岛原半岛（岛原市、雲仙市、南岛原市）
location.en: Shimabara Peninsula, Nagasaki Prefecture (Shimabara, Unzen and Minamishimabara cities)

zh: 雲仙地狱（じごく）：沸腾的泥浆与硫磺喷气孔，是雲仙温泉的标志性景观
平成新山（普贤岳熔岩穹丘）：1990年喷发形成的熔岩穹，可从仁田峠眺望
岛原城与土石流资料馆：直观呈现1991年火山灾害的现场遗址
en: Unzen Jigoku (Hell): bubbling mud pools and sulphur fumaroles, the iconic symbol of Unzen Onsen
Heisei Shinzan lava dome: formed in the 1990 eruption, best viewed from Nita Pass
Shimabara Castle and Disaster Memorial Museum: on-site preserved ruins of the 1991 pyroclastic flow

admission.zh: 仁田峠循环道路通行费约500日元；博物馆约620日元
admission.en: Nita Pass toll road ~¥500; Disaster Memorial Museum ~¥620

tips.zh: 从长崎市乘岛铁巴士约2小时可达岛原；雲仙温泉地狱周边散步路线全程约1小时，沿途气场十足。
tips.en: Shimabara is about 2 hours from Nagasaki by Shimabara Railway bus. The Jigoku walking circuit around Unzen Onsen takes roughly 1 hour and is free to stroll.
